workspace_experiment.decision: Root metadata grouping succeeds, but this creates a new shared resolution/lockfile contract; retain existing per-manifest lockfiles and CI selection in this visitor fix. Root make targets offer the needed convenience without a new dependency topology. A future workspace migration needs reviewed lockfile and CI parity evidence.
workspace_experiment.scope: No production manifests or lockfiles modified; no build executed in probe.
workspace_experiment.locked_resolution_stderr: Root Cargo.lock needs to be updated but --locked prevents the update.
